# Third-party code

## minimp3 (third_party/minimp3.h)

A tiny MP3 decoder in one header file, by lieff.
Source: https://github.com/lieff/minimp3
License: CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication). No attribution is required, and it
may be used in commercial products. Included here so the game needs no extra
system library to play the title song.
